scope: Original pure default renderer bodies, original Canvas layer loops, original transition functions and original source-preparation/computed-link fragments execute without rewriting their algorithms. Canvas operations forward to actual Playwright Chromium Canvas2D, including requested/applied paint. This is not React hook/lifecycle equivalence or final force-layout position equivalence.

policy.rustCompatibility: Factory inherit preserves the existing Rust Scene, not Nivo defaults. Native linkThickness 0 is assigned and ignored by real Canvas2D, retaining its previous positive width; Rust need not reproduce that unchecked paint quirk. SVG NetworkLink declares round caps while original Canvas link leaves the inherited cap unchanged. Canvas default renderers do not assign globalAlpha; zero alpha still calls them.
policy.callbackOrder: Native Canvas walks provided computed arrays/layers without sorting or ink-based culling. Rust Swarm factory preserves its existing packed-site order; it does not claim original force simulation source order.
policy.source: Nivo Swarm source preparation shallow-copies raw data; computed-link fields use original raw index and computed source/target objects. Native concatenated parallel-link ids collide; Rust retains explicit relation ids or source indices.
policy.failure: Explicit callback throw stops remaining native iteration; its earlier Canvas operations remain. Rust checked layout/publication rejection must instead preserve the accepted whole frame.
